adjudication.rationale: The finding is accurate. In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 23-25, when refresh_token is missing from the response, the code sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (a literal string sentinel). In office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts line 264, the code does `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`, which spreads the parsed response over existing credentials. This means the fabricated "refresh_token" string will overwrite the real stored refresh_token, causing subsequent refresh attempts to fail with an invalid grant. This is a real bug that would break token refresh for Office 365 and potentially other providers.
